revision_choices_and_limits.voices: Baochai's calculation competes with desire for light and exhaustion at explaining; Sheyue's walking, fire tending and night work are not free and her resentment need not dissolve into jokes; Baoyu wants to retain objects and contribute, but practical mistakes and defensiveness do not end in a declaration of complete understanding.
revision_choices_and_limits.moving: Frame tried once, then genuinely left with old owner's consent. Local bedding/clothes/felt/pot transport and arrival enacted; lost ordinary bowl remains unfound and inconvenient. No registered bedding group state or transfer ledger altered.
revision_choices_and_limits.pawn_cash: Real coat delivery and shop inspection precede money/ticket; rice bought first, dry charcoal later costs oil purchase. Oil only priced, not bought. No precise rent, pawn amount/interest/term, medicine debt total or guaranteed future income.
revision_choices_and_limits.ticket_inheritance: Actual baseline line67 establishes storage inside old sewing-box bottom with small paper tickets. New prose naturally stores it once at 匣底, not outside under a box corner. Retained parent remains unmodified. Rent receipt has its own earlier collection scene, without repeated location audits.
revision_choices_and_limits.rice: Two-and-a-half explicitly means served cooked porridge in this chapter; raw rice measured separately. No conversion or claim to resolve chapter96 raw-rice ambiguity; chapter96 untouched.
revision_choices_and_limits.daily_life: Radish leaves lead to a bounded mutual sewing request, not major rescue. Sour-food laughter, 今日这口正好, small wooden bowl, questions about tomorrow's meal and door-closing speech retained.
revision_choices_and_limits.night: Window repair tears brittle paper further, deferred sewing and oil costs have consequences, old felt remains incomplete and next winter uncertain; wind and night labor persist after lying down.
revision_choices_and_limits.unsettled_bills: Medicine balance remains to be asked about, coat money does not clear all bills; tomorrow's rice is present but no perpetual supply implied.
revision_choices_and_limits.authority: Second winter and marital poverty remain current C-level research arrangement; no historical proof, recovered original, independent human/provider verdict, semantic acceptance or adoption claimed.
revision_choices_and_limits.unknowns: Scene-to-world/object/knowledge ledger transitions, exact quantities and cash duration remain unresolved; no new jade identification, loss or destiny explanation.
